description.value: Hanlin Tea House specializes in tea and patisseries, located in Richmond with indoor seating available. It serves as a casual refreshment stop for touring cyclists seeking tea and pastry items.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 47m; rack at 76m.
